subject: New objection category needs-redesign: implementer says the architecture cannot carry the requirement
objective: An implementer can write 'OBJECTION: needs-redesign <one line>' in EVIDENCE; it is recorded on the ticket under its own category (not folded into ticket-wrong), blocks land/close until disposed, and is judged by the opener on the same triage path as ticket-wrong, where the triage dispatch tells the opener: accepted only if the ticket can be rewritten within the current architecture, otherwise escalate with a question proposing a design session (D-019). The implementer card and the dispatch rule text name the new category in the same ticket (D-054 Q12).
acceptance: A1 ticket.py objection with line 'OBJECTION: needs-redesign X' adds a row whose category is exactly needs-redesign, owner main, body X
A2 a ticket holding an undisposed needs-redesign row (no explicit blocking key) is refused by close and by the Done/land objection check, same message family as ticket-wrong
A3 auto-fix: a worker EVIDENCE with a needs-redesign line starts the opener triage (objection.triage.start category=needs-redesign), not the test_defect verifier path

A4 the opener triage dispatch for a needs-redesign objection contains the needs-redesign judging rule (accepted only within current architecture; else escalate proposing a design session); for a ticket-wrong objection that rule line is absent
A5 review.sh fail with an 'OBJECTION: needs-redesign X' line records category needs-redesign (not ticket-wrong)

A6 every place that prints the category list to agents (auto-fix dispatch texts, DISPATCH-TEMPLATE section 8 item 7, implementer card, SCHEMA objection rows, WORKFLOW objection section) lists four categories; checked by reviewer reading, not by a doc-consistency test (D-054 Q12: pinning copies with tests is the multi-copy symptom)
A7 existing ticket-wrong / test_defect / blocking tests unchanged and green; unknown category still falls back to ticket-wrong

Mutation: drop needs-redesign from OBJECTION_CATEGORIES -> category becomes ticket-wrong -> red. T2 (A2, unit, tests/test_ticket.py): fixture ticket Ready with objections=[{category: needs-redesign, body, owner: main, disposition: ''}] and no blocking key; ticket.py close <n> -> rc != 0 and output contains 'needs-redesign'; with disposition 'accepted' -> that refusal gone. Mutation: remove needs-redesign from the blocking default set in objection_problems -> red. T3 (A3+A4, integration, tests/test_objection_triage.py, reuse its fake-opener fixture): worker EVIDENCE with 'OBJECTION: needs-redesign X'; expect event objection.triage.start with category needs-redesign and no verifier dispatch for that round; captured opener dispatch file contains the literal rule sentence chosen by the worker (assert on a fixed substring the test declares, e.g. 'needs-redesign'+'design session' in the 判反駁 section); same fixture with ticket-wrong line -> that rule substring absent. T4 (A5, integration, existing review.sh test module): reviewer output 'OBJECTION: needs-redesign X' on fail -> ticket row category needs-redesign. T5 (A7): existing test_ticket / test_objection_triage / test_auto_fix / test_apply green unchanged; add one assertion that 'OBJECTION: bogus X' still records ticket-wrong. A6 is reviewer-read only (list the files in EVIDENCE).
